\textit{sec:refit-bound} \ (**THE WAVENUMBER TRUNCATION WAS 78\% OF THE CONTROL'S REMAINING chi\textasciicircum{}2, AND REMOVING IT TAKES THE CONTROL TO chi\textasciicircum{}2/dof = 1.18 OVER THE FULL RANGE AGAINST A TRUE LambdaCDM FIT'S 1.01 -- SO FRONT \#2's TARGET IS MET. Run KCONT=1 to check.'* **Run: agreement better than 0.7\% everywhere, chi\textasciicircum{}2 to 2.1 in 51817.** *That check existed for the PEAK POSITION and had never been run against the statistic the verdict reads.* **PART 4 FOUR INSTRUMENT STATES, full range, both arms on the same lensing operator: the control 21.2 -> 27.7 -> 5.34 -> 1.18 and the CR arm 290.7 -> 304.2 -> 298.9 -> 302.1.** *An error the INSTRUMENT carries moves both arms; this moved one -- eighteenfold against 5\%.* **PART 5 F2 AND F3 AS `L-147` DEFINES THEM, WITH BOTH ARMS AT THE SAME WAVENUMBER RANGE** so the construction is not charged for the instrument's truncation. Full range **F2 = 31 and F3 = 51848**; below ell = 700 **F2 = 3.8 and F3 = 23687**; below ell = 500 F2 = \ensuremath{-}0.2, the arm scoring no worse than the reference. **F4's second clause fires by three orders of magnitude where it asks for one.**).

\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**A SEEDED-DEFECT TEST WHOSE SEED STOPS CONSTRUCTING THE DEFECT DOES NOT GO QUIET --- IT ACCUSES THE GATE IT WAS BUILT TO DEFEND.** `L-558`'s `D1` seeds `check\_protected\_dupes` by doubling a protected row with a differing strike marker, and built that seed from the literal `.replace('**PO-6**', '\textasciitilde{}\textasciitilde{}**PO-6**\textasciitilde{}\textasciitilde{}', 1)` written while `PO-6` was OPEN. `PO-6` has since been STRUCK, so the row reads `\textbar{} \textasciitilde{}\textasciitilde{}**PO-6**\textasciitilde{}\textasciitilde{} \textbar{}` and the replace produced a mangled marker rather than a duplicate row: **the gate saw nothing, exited 0, and the receipt printed `SEEDED 0` and called it a GATE FAILURE.** So a stale seed does not degrade to a no-op --- **it inverts**, because a control that constructs nothing measures the gate against a clean tree. **And the same movement --- the register moving in the direction the corpus wants --- broke two repair-verifications at four sites:** `L-551`'s `R1` and `L-555`'s `M1` each read a repair's pre-state from a SHA and its post-state from the WORKING TREE. **`M1` carried that very rule in its own comments,** written there by c54.222 which hit it once and left three further live reads twenty lines below.).

It now reads only the leading comment block.).

\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**A FINDING THAT ROUTES ITS OWN REMEDY AND THEN RECURS IS NOT WAITING FOR A DECISION --- IT IS ACCUMULATING COST WHILE ONE IS NOT MADE.** r3112 (`L-251`) found that two lines numbering from one counter collide, named the remedy --- a BAND --- and routed it as "not a node's call". **Three more collisions arrived in the fourteen revisions that followed: `r3103`, `r3104` and `r3112` itself**, the revision that reported the class. \textit{corpus integrity} \ (**A THREE-CLAUSE ROW STRUCK AS A WHOLE CARRIES ONE VERDICT WORD PER CLAUSE, AND A CLAUSE WHOSE HONEST VERDICT IS "NOT OURS" READS, IN THE STRIKE'S GRAMMAR, AS "DONE".** Clearing `check\_open\_ledger`'s five unverdicted qualifications turned up `P07` saying of the ultraviolet definition of the mode sums that **"the shared character of the wall does not settle it"** and that it is **"a genuine open frontier \ldots{} carried as such and to be worked"**, against `PO-6` --- **STRUCK r3001, 582 revisions later** --- whose clause (3) reads **"THE UV DEFINITION: MET, NOT OWED"**. **They agree.** `kills/PO-6.md`'s argument is that CR's SPECIFIC part is bounded to a one-dimensional counterterm basis by conformal flatness --- "a generic problem on unusually good terms" --- so "not owed" means CR adds no burden of its own, and `P10` says the same in the same words. **Nothing is unstruck; the reconciliation is written into the ledger entry so the next reader does not re-open the row on a reading.**).

\item[\label{rcpt:M1_five_checks_pinned_to_things_that_move_and_one_that_no_control_could_separate}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{M1\_five\_checks\_pinned\_to\_things\_that\_move\_and\_one\_that\_no\_control\_could\_separate}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\

The `\&\&` binds the generator to the LOOP and the `echo` is a separate command that runs unconditionally --- so a failed generator skipped every gate and printed the pass. **It cost a revision:** `L-265`'s register row used three glyphs the generator had no entry for, and r3152 was committed with `check\_appendix\_current` RED. The generator was right and loud, as `L-262` left it; the sweep never asked it. **And the sweep was sixteen of eighty-nine instruments** --- two of the red gates had never been run by this line at all. **A hand-carried list of instruments measures the list, not the tree.**). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: the idiom reproduced in a subprocess, printing the pass with the loop skipped, **with the control** showing the loop does run when the first command succeeds; the three untranslatable glyphs read from the row as committed at r3152 and their absence from that commit's generator table; the gate count, 16 hand-carried against 89 present, and the two red gates never in the list; the new instrument's glob, its verdict-from-runs, its timeout-is-red rule and its `NODE=ci`; **SEEDED** --- pointed at a tree whose generator fails and whose only gate is green, it exits 1 and does not print a pass; and the nine red gates, each verified to have existed before this line's work began (14 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity. **NOT claimed:** that the nine red gates are this line's to fix --- six are register and routing bookkeeping in the other line's lane, one is a stale cache, two were never seen, and what is claimed is that they are now visible; that the hand-rolled sweep was useless --- it caught real defects all session on the sixteen it covered; that r3152's finding is affected --- station (G)'s result is independent of appendix generation; that `\&\&` is the culprit --- the culprit is a success message not produced by the thing it reports on.
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L267\_the\_sweep\_that\_did\_not\_run/G1\_a\_success\_message\_printed\_by\_a\_different\_command\_than\_the\_one\_it\_describes.py}

\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**A RECEIPT THAT ASSERTS A STATE ITS OWN REVISION CHANGES IS FALSE AT THE MOMENT IT IS COMMITTED.** `L-263`'s `S1` struck three reach stations in `OWED` 609 --- which is what the revision was for --- and two of its checks then asserted that `OWED` still carried one of them as owed. The check and the edit that falsifies it are in the same diff. **This is the fifth disguise of `L-258`'s class and it is different in kind from the other four:** a live directory, a live register, a section title, reworded prose, a distance from HEAD, the state of a granted request --- all are "the world moved under a check", and each was TRUE when written. This one never was. **So care about the past does not protect against it**; the claim must be read at the commit that holds the state, and when the revision changes it, that commit is the parent.). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: the offending predicate read from the commit that carried it; that the same commit edits the file it read, by its own stat; the searched string present at the parent and absent at the commit, so the predicate was false in the tree it was committed to; that the strike was the revision's purpose; the four earlier disguises located in the register; that the repaired form reads the absence at the parent and asserts the present in the opposite direction; and that `L-263/S1` exits 0 (13 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity. **NOT claimed:** that `L-263`'s finding is affected --- three stations are held in the papers and every check establishing that reads the PAPERS, untouched here; that a receipt may never read a file its revision edits --- it may and must, to assert the edit landed, and what fails is reading it for the state BEFORE; that this is a new class --- it is `L-258`'s, and a class's record is the list of its disguises.
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L268\_broken\_by\_its\_own\_edit/O1\_a\_receipt\_that\_asserts\_a\_state\_its\_own\_revision\_changes\_is\_false\_when\_committed.py}

\item[\label{rcpt:S1_the_first_programme_is_a_power_calculation_and_the_design_it_proposes_is_the_expensive_one}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{S1\_the\_first\_programme\_is\_a\_power\_calculation\_and\_the\_design\_it\_proposes\_is\_the\_expensive\_one}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**THE STATISTICS BAKE, `S1` --- WHAT BIT: `A5.5`'S FIRST PROGRAMME IS A POWER CALCULATION, AND THE DESIGN IT PROPOSES IS THE EXPENSIVE ONE.** `P06` states Lemma `A5.5` falsifiably and calls the sampling that would test it the discipline's first programme. It is careful about every SELECTION question a statistician would raise --- survivorship, censoring, the applied-and-disregarded episodes --- and **never asks whether the reference class can be big enough.** "Falsifiable" is a property of the statement; **detectable** is a property of the design, and it is a number. Computed exactly: the two-arm design it proposes needs **38 / 72 / 168** episodes for 80\% power at three effect sizes; the paired design its own material supports needs **8 / 18 / 37**, because within a theory-choice episode the candidates are mutually exclusive and the between-episode variance is never paid for. **168 clean theory-choice episodes with a decisive non-local measurement is not a population the history of physics holds.** And the five celebrated instances, read as a paired sign test, would already give \$p=0.031\$ --- and may not be so read, on the paper's own ground, because they were selected because they succeeded. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **The binding constraint moves from sample size to SELECTION DISCIPLINE, and `pre-registration` is \ensuremath{\times}0 in seventeen papers.**). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: exact Fisher one-sided \$p\$ over every table the two-arm design can produce and exact power by enumeration; the exact binomial sign test for the paired design; **both validated against `scipy` over 2304 tables and 460 binomial cases BEFORE use, the receipt refusing to report figures it has not checked**; each design's floor --- the smallest class at which a perfect result reaches \$0.05\$, six episodes against five; the empty-comparator case returning \$p=1\$ exactly at 5/5, 20/20 and 100/100; the episodes each design needs for 80\% power across a grid fixed before the computation; the discreteness sawtooth, where ten episodes give less power than eight; and the de-macroed vocabulary survey that measured the opening before anything was called a hole (20 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity; no paper edited. **NOT claimed:** that `A5.5` is true or false --- nothing here estimates the effect and the lemma is exactly as open after the bake as before; that the effect-size grid is the right one --- it was fixed before the computation and is reported whole; that the paired design is always available --- it needs well-defined live candidates per episode and the two-arm figures stand as the fallback; that the paper is wrong to call the lemma falsifiable --- it is, and what is added is that falsifiable and detectable are different properties; that this criticises the sampling discussion --- that discussion is better than most, which is why the missing power statement is worth naming.
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L271\_the\_statistics\_bake/S1\_the\_first\_programme\_is\_a\_power\_calculation\_and\_the\_design\_it\_proposes\_is\_the\_expensive\_one.py}
\item[\label{rcpt:S2_the_systematics_budget_is_absent_by_name_and_present_as_a_matched_control}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{S2\_the\_systematics\_budget\_is\_absent\_by\_name\_and\_present\_as\_a\_matched\_control}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**THE STATISTICS BAKE, `S2` --- WHAT BOUNCED: THE SYSTEMATICS BUDGET IS ABSENT BY NAME AND PRESENT AS A MATCHED CONTROL.** Seventeen papers carry `systematics` \ensuremath{\times}0, `systematic error` \ensuremath{\times}0, `nuisance` \ensuremath{\times}0 and `beam` \ensuremath{\times}0 --- beside a **seventy-sigma** disagreement quoted against Planck. That reads like the sharpest finding in the bake and it is a bounce: read, `P15` measures a \$\textbackslash\{\}Lambda\$CDM control **by the identical procedure** and differences against it, reporting that "the control stands in for the sky on this quantity to within seven parts in a thousand of the disagreement it is used to measure". **Any error the procedure makes on the sky it makes on the control, and differencing removes it --- which is what a systematics budget buys.** The paper does not overclaim either: it says outright that the number "should not be read as the disagreement itself", and elsewhere refuses a likelihood it judges unable to arbitrate. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **A method present, correct and unnamed --- the fourth instance, after the Atiyah sequence (`L-265`), \$N\_\{\textbackslash\{\}rm eff\}\$ ((9)) and the baby universe ((10)).** *The corpus's characteristic failure is not error; it is anonymity.*). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: the de-macroed absence of nine systematics terms across the seventeen paper bodies, against `standard deviations` and `dof` present, so the zeros are measured; the seventy-sigma ratio reproduced from the paper's own two numbers, \$0.615/0.008=76.9\$; the Gaussian tail at that ratio, which **underflows double precision to zero** while \$5\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$ is a reportable \$5.7\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-7\}\$ --- the demonstration that the figure carries a ratio and not a probability; the matched-control sentences located in `P15` verbatim; the **robustness factor**, \$25.6\textbackslash\{\}times\$, being how badly the quoted \$\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$ would have to be wrong before the separation fell to three sigma; and the three prior unnamed-method instances counted out of the register rather than declared (17 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity; no paper edited. **NOT claimed:** that the seventy sigma is wrong --- it is reproduced from the paper's own numbers and it is right; that a systematics section is owed --- what is owed is a sentence naming what the control is doing, plus the robustness factor; that matched-procedure differencing removes ALL systematics --- it removes those common to the two measurements, and an error affecting one arm survives it; that `plik\_lite`'s own marginalisation is being relied on here --- the seventy-sigma denominator is a hand-propagated resolution scale, and the two are distinguished; that `P15` is careless with statistics --- the same section says "the ordering is a fact and the ratio is not a \$p\$-value" and "the likelihood cannot arbitrate here".
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L271\_the\_statistics\_bake/S2\_the\_systematics\_budget\_is\_absent\_by\_name\_and\_present\_as\_a\_matched\_control.py}

\item[\label{rcpt:C1_the_weyl_closure_is_generic_to_cubics_and_the_match_is_D3_alone}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{C1\_the\_weyl\_closure\_is\_generic\_to\_cubics\_and\_the\_match\_is\_D3\_alone}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**THE CARTAN / HOLONOMY BAKE --- first of the four fields `L-272`'s re-survey left outstanding, thrown r3164.** `P07` and `P14` report that the residue pairing's holonomy about the Nariai points, "adjoined to the walls' \$S\_3\$, closes the Weyl group of \$\textbackslash\{\}so(6,\textbackslash\{\}mathbb\{C\})\$ --- so the excess is substrate-derived rather than assumed." **CONFIRMED FROM SCRATCH:** continuing three roots of \$r\textasciicircum{}3-r+2M\$ and three branches of \$\textbackslash\{\}sqrt\{f'(r\_i)\}\$ around each Nariai point and around infinity gives transpositions, a 3-cycle, the thrice-punctured sphere's relation on the roots, and a group of **order 24** whose root image is \$S\_3\$ and whose kernel is exactly `P05`'s Klein four-group --- element-order profile \$S\_4\$'s and no other order-24 group's, with no group theory put in. **BIT:** four further cubic families return the identical group, so **the closure is generic to one-parameter cubics and the horizon cubic is not special here.** "Substrate-derived rather than assumed" is sound about the derivation and misplaces the surprise: the group is forced by the cubic; what is not forced is that the substrate's Weyl group is the same group. **AND THAT MATCH IS \$D\_3\$ ALONE** --- among every classical and exceptional Weyl group of rank two or more, 24 selects \$A\_3=D\_3\$ and nothing else, the two coinciding by \$\textbackslash\{\}so(6,\textbackslash\{\}mathbb\{C\})\textbackslash\{\}cong\textbackslash\{\}mathfrak\{sl\}(4,\textbackslash\{\}mathbb\{C\})\$. **A rank-three fact, in the shape of `P03`'s `rem:dimension`.** **BOUNCED:** the two-transposition generation of the deck \$S\_3\$ is `P05`'s `prop:monodromy`, with `rem:monodromy-group` stating the condition a naive version misses.). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: the root and square-root monodromy continued numerically around both Nariai points and around infinity, giving two transpositions, a 3-cycle, and \$\textbackslash\{\}gamma\_+\textbackslash\{\}gamma\_-\textbackslash\{\}gamma\_\textbackslash\{\}infty=1\$ on the roots; the group generated, its order, its root image, its kernel and its element-order profile, identified as \$S\_4\$; **controls in both directions** --- a loop enclosing no Nariai point returns the identity and one lasso alone returns a group of order four, so 24 is a measurement --- and robustness across base points and lasso radii; the same analysis on four further cubic families, all returning the identical group; the Weyl orders of \$A\$, \$B/C\$ and \$D\$ at ranks two through six against 24, and the exceptional orders; `P05`'s own propositions located verbatim; and the bundle apparatus surveyed word-bounded at \ensuremath{\times}0 (20 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity; no paper edited. **NOT claimed:** that the corpus is wrong --- the group, the Klein four-group, the \$S\_3\$ and the closure are all independently confirmed; that "substrate-derived" is false --- the derivation is genuinely from the residue pairing, and genericity moves where the weight belongs rather than voiding it; that the match is a coincidence in the dismissive sense --- it is an exact low-rank isomorphism, and the claim is that it is a fact about \$\textbackslash\{\}so(6,\textbackslash\{\}mathbb\{C\})\$ rather than about the cubic; that the missing apparatus is an error --- what is owed is the name of a theorem; that the bake reached the CONNECTION --- it computed the monodromy of the cubic, and the identification is the papers' own, stated as unreached in the ledger's boundary.

\item[\label{rcpt:H1_the_low_multipole_deficit_is_two_effects_and_the_ladder_imprint_dies_where_the_transfer_is_narrow}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{H1\_the\_low\_multipole\_deficit\_is\_two\_effects\_and\_the\_ladder\_imprint\_dies\_where\_the\_transfer\_is\_narrow}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{corpus integrity} \ (**THE HARMONIC-ANALYSIS BAKE --- second of the four fields `L-272`'s re-survey left outstanding, thrown r3166.** **BOUNCED, and largely:** the field's first question is why a closed-\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$ source is projected through FLAT spherical Bessel functions, and `P15` answers it in its own text --- the distance slicing is flat, so only the source modes carry the closed-\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$ quantization --- while its measure \$w\_L=(L+1)/(L(L+2))\$ is derived twice, as degeneracy over per-mode power and as \$d\textbackslash\{\}ln k\_L/dL\$, both agreeing to machine precision. **BIT:** the deficit reported as one geometric effect splits exactly into a **FLOOR** (modes below \$L\{=\}2\$ removed) and a **LADDER COARSENESS**. At \$\textbackslash\{\}ell=5\$--6 the second contributes \$+0.38\$ against a floor of \$0.27\$--\$0.53\$ --- comparable, and in the opposite direction --- and it is what sets the recovery multipole the paper quotes (\$\textbackslash\{\}ell=8\$ with it, \$\textbackslash\{\}ell=10\$ without). Under \$\textbackslash\{\}pm2\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ in \$r\_0\$ the floor moves \$-2.4\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ to \$-6.2\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ and the full result \$+27.8\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ to \$-43.3\textbackslash\{\}\%\$: **the location is the floor and is robust as claimed; the depth is the ladder and is volatile**, which gives the paper's own qualitative split a mechanism. **AND A SELF-WAIVED GATE BECOMES A BOUND:** `P15` records that the ladder "samples the projection below the rate the instrument's own aliasing gate demands, and that gate waives itself on the claim that the ladder is physical." The imprint dies at \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}simeq k\_2D\_Ce\textasciicircum{}\{3\textbackslash\{\}sigma\}\$; to reach the first acoustic peak the transfer would need to draw power over a factor of nine in \$k\$. **Safe with a wide margin, by measurement.**). 
\emph{Computes:} COMPUTES: the spherical-Bessel completeness identity \$\textbackslash\{\}sum\_\textbackslash\{\}ell(2\textbackslash\{\}ell+1)j\_\textbackslash\{\}ell(x)\textasciicircum{}2=1\$ to ten figures and the exact plateau \$\textbackslash\{\}int j\_\textbackslash\{\}ell\textasciicircum{}2 d\textbackslash\{\}ln x=1/(2\textbackslash\{\}ell(\textbackslash\{\}ell+1))\$ reproduced on the fixed grid to six, both **before anything is used**; the measure against \$d\textbackslash\{\}ln k\_L/dL\$ and against degeneracy-over-power at five \$L\$; the paper's own \$D\_C/r\_0\textbackslash\{\}to0\$ limit; the floor/discreteness decomposition across \$\textbackslash\{\}ell=2\$--12; each half's response to \$\textbackslash\{\}pm2\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ in \$r\_0\$; the recovery multipole with and without the discreteness; and the imprint against transfer width at four \$\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$, with the scaling rule checked against all four rather than extrapolated (15 checks).
 \emph{Bound:} NOT-A-PAPER-CLAIM --- corpus integrity; no paper edited. **NOT claimed:** that the deficit is wrong --- every number touched is reproduced or confirmed, the paper's own limit included; that these are predictions about the sky --- the decomposition is the pure Sachs--Wolfe limit while the paper's depths come from a genuine Boltzmann transfer it says are milder, and the two are not compared; that the real transfer's width is measured --- \$\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$ is a Gaussian-in-\$\textbackslash\{\}ln k\$ stand-in and measuring \$\textbackslash\{\}Delta\_\textbackslash\{\}ell(k)\$ is the owed next step; that the aliasing gate should stop waiving --- only that the waiver now has a margin; that the low-\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$ oscillation is derived rather than measured.

Re-fitting all three statistics to data truncated at a succession of ceilings, the licensed-minus-forbidden excess runs \$-1.0\$, \$+14.4\$, \$+51.0\$, \$+67.9\$, \$+74.7\$, \$+84.0\$, \$+88.3\$, \$+93.8\$ from \$\textbackslash\{\}ell=850\$ to \$1996\$; about half the full-range gap falls in \$850<\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}le1500\$ and about a third below \$850\$, where the truncated fit absorbs it entirely. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***AND AT EVERY TRUNCATION THE FORBIDDEN ARM SITS WITHIN ABOUT ONE UNIT OF THE CONTROL***, which a flatness produced by distance from a ceiling would not do. **So what the comparison carries is a rigidity across scales --- onset between \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}simeq850\$ and \$1000\$, decisive by \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}simeq1200\$, and *not* converged, growing \$+5.5\$ in the last 96 multipoles.**  The paper's word is therefore *localised in onset*; *confined to high multipole* would be wrong, which is the one correction the audit asked of the paper} \ (node 66's `r7101` Q1 ordered the audit from the seat that did not produce the comparison, naming the ceiling-artefact mechanism as the thing it most wanted tried against; node 70 pre-registered it and returned all three counts clear. **The figures then had no receipt, which is why this one exists: the measurement is 70's and the assertion that the paper quotes it correctly is the gate's**). 
\emph{Computes:} **17 checks, all pass.** Nothing of its own: it DRIVES 70's `r7101\_70\_three\_grid\_audit/audit.py` as a subprocess from that file's own directory and parses its printed tables --- one \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$ sampling (\$100..1996\$) across all three grids with the control byte-identical; the per-arm reach, with \$D\_M\$ differing (\$14011.5\$ against \$13941.6\$ Mpc) while \$k\_\{\textbackslash\{\}max\}D\_M\$ does not; the eight truncation gaps to a tenth; their monotonicity and non-convergence; the forbidden arm within \$1.1\$ of the control at every truncation; and the six band shares
 \emph{Bound:}  **NO TRANSFER, SPECTRUM, LIKELIHOOD OR FIT IS COMPUTED HERE, AND NO ARRAY LIBRARY IS LOADED IN THE PROCESS AT ALL** --- a second implementation of someone else's audit would be a different number wearing the same name.  **And one thing is explicitly NOT asserted:** that the two grids came from one instrument *revision*. Neither stamp carries the source hash, so it is inferred from every shared log line agreeing; the configuration writer that records it landed on `cc66`'s branch in the same round and closes this by construction for the next pair
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_three\_grid\_comparison\_is\_like\_for\_like\_and\_not\_a\_ceiling\_artefact\_because\_the\_projection\_reach\_is\_fixed\_on\_every\_arm.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_controls_base_log_is_banked_beside_the_grids_and_the_peak_heights_concur_with_the_three_rigidity_statistics}{P15R235}\textbf{P15R235}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_controls\_base\_log\_is\_banked\_beside\_the\_grids\_and\_the\_peak\_heights\_concur\_with\_the\_three\_rigidity\_statistics}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:refit-bound` ---  **THE PEAK-HEIGHT CELL `70`'s THREE-GRID AUDIT LEFT EMPTY IS FILLED, AND IT IS A *CONCORDANT* SIGN: THE FORBIDDEN CONFIGURATION'S HEIGHTS ARE THE CONTROL'S OWN AT \$0.18\$ ON TWO DEGREES OF FREEDOM IN THE DATA'S OWN UNITS, WHERE THE LICENSED ONE'S ARE \$2.83\$ AWAY.** The audit closes *"the control's base has no log banked beside the grids; its peak ratios are not compared here"* --- the arm's two logs print \$P\_1/P\_2 = 2.283\$ licensed and \$2.199\$ forbidden, and with no control row the second reading could not be told from its own opposite: either the forbidden heights are BETTER, a contrary sign, or they are THE CONTROL'S, which is what its \$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2\$, its crossings and its longest run already are. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***IT IS THE SECOND, AND NOT CLOSE: the control's own base reads \$2.196\$ / \$2.190\$, and the forbidden arm's \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$ is the control's to \$1.6\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-5\}\$ while the licensed one's is \$1.51\$ away --- so the heights were being read on an arm that had already collapsed in its geometry.***  **AND THE SAME STATISTIC SHOWS THE CELL COULD NEVER HAVE HELD A CONTRARY SIGN.** Against the sky on two degrees of freedom: banked \$0.85\$, licensed \$1.05\$, forbidden \$0.44\$, control \$0.59\$ --- **every one inside \$1.1\$, and the two ratios do not agree on an ordering.** *The apparent sign came from quoting a \$0.084\$ difference against a sky number carrying no bar: the sky's own ratios are \$2.2564\textbackslash\{\}pm0.0772\$ and \$2.2800\textbackslash\{\}pm0.0737\$ from the published covariance's own block, so \$0.084\$ is a fifth of the resolution.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **\$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2\$ keeps its standing as the statistic with the information --- it separates \$278.79\$ from \$184.99\$ where the heights separate \$1.05\$ from \$0.44\$** --- which is `c54.176`'s conclusion arriving a second time by a second route.  *And the control's base log is now banked beside both grids: the ORIGINAL stdout of the run whose `.npz` IS the banked `lcdm\_base.npz` (one file in three places, md5 `5df16bcd`), so it is the record of the artefact and not a re-run's description of a re-run.*} \ (node 66's `r7109` (2), which named this cell rather than ordering it: *"the one earlier disagreement between the heights and the three rigidity statistics is currently an empty cell rather than a contrary sign, and it should be one or the other"* --- itself `70`'s request carried forward). 
\emph{Computes:} **All checks pass.** **(1)** the banked log is the log of the banked ARTEFACT: the control's `.npz` asserted byte-identical across `refit\_grid185/` and both grids, the two banked log copies asserted identical, the log asserted to name its own output, and the audit's blank QUOTED from the audit so the premise is not remembered. The scope gate asks `git ls-files --error-unmatch` over all twelve inputs rather than `os.path.exists`. **(2)** the four readings recomputed at full precision through the instrument's OWN peak line (`argrelextrema(Dl, greater, order=3)`), and asserted to reproduce each banked log's printed pair **to its three decimals and not finer**. **(3)** the sky's pair and its \$3.2\$--\$3.4\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ bars re-derived through `c54.176`'s route from the full \$3\textbackslash\{\}times3\$ covariance block propagated to both ratios at once (correlation \$+0.73\$ --- they share \$P\_1\$). **(4)** the matched statistic: the models carried through CAMB's non-perturbative lensed/unlensed operator (checked at its own \$+6.5\textbackslash\{\}\%\$ at \$\textbackslash\{\}ell=1900\$), binned by the likelihood's own binning, the same peak finder on the same \$185\$-bin window, and ONE 2-dof number per arm. Asserted: forbidden \$<0.5\$ from the control, licensed \$>1.0\$, forbidden \$<\$ licensed\$/4\$, every arm \$<1.2\$ against the sky. **CONTROL THAT FIRES: the fine-grid unlensed route must reproduce the matched route's sign (\$0.046\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$ against \$1.124\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$), or the result is called an artefact of the binning or the operator.** **(5)** the one run `r7109` (2) budgeted, spent as the INDEPENDENT CHECK rather than as the record: the instrument at this revision, at the control's own settings, returns the banked control --- `ls`, \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$, \$D\_M\$, \$r\_s\$ **bit-identical** and \$D\_\textbackslash\{\}ell\$ to \$6.8\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-15\}\$, the same cross-machine reduction order the `DAMPX` pair showed against `r4494` (\$6.4\textbackslash\{\}times 10\textasciicircum{}\{-15\}\$), *reported as relaxed rather than asserted as bit-identical*. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **And since `LEAFREC` defaults to \$1\$ since `r7095+cc66.75` while the bank predates the flip, the `LEAFREC` no-op on the control is MEASURED here on the reporting path at production settings rather than inherited.** It degrades with a named reason when the run is absent, PARTS 1--4 not depending on it.
 \emph{Bound:}  **IT DOES NOT MAKE THE HEIGHTS A VERDICT, AND SAYS SO IN ITS OWN HEADLINE:** the concordance is the sign, and the abstention is the other half --- no arm is separable from the sky by this statistic, so (b) is reported as a null and not as support.  **AND IT NAMES A DEFECT IT DOES NOT SWEEP:** the instrument carries **two sky references in one file** --- the non-`DSCAN` print's bare \$2.217\$ / \$2.277\$, which is the line the audit read, beside the `DSCAN` print's \$2.256\textbackslash\{\}pm3.4\textbackslash\{\}\%\$. *The bare pair is not WRONG --- asserted inside \$1\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$ of the propagated one, which `c54.176` also asserts --- it is BARE.* **A dozen registered receipts carry \$2.217\$ as `SKY` and the protocol is the paper's, so it is ROUTED to the gate rather than swept.** NOT CLAIMED: that the lensed-model/binned-sky route is the corpus's settled protocol (it is this receipt's, built to match the sky's own route, and the fine-grid route is carried beside it as the control); that \$\textbackslash\{\}texttt\{LEAFGEOM=1\}\$ is reinstated --- `r7095`'s ruling is the gate's and the default is untouched.

\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_133_bin_pair_is_computed_and_asserted_and_the_hardcoded_row_carried_the_other_arm}{P15R236}\textbf{P15R236}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_133\_bin\_pair\_is\_computed\_and\_asserted\_and\_the\_hardcoded\_row\_carried\_the\_other\_arm}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:refit-bound`, `sec:diffusion-scale` ---  **THE TWO FIGURES THE CORPUS QUOTES FOR THE \$133\$-BIN COMPARISON ARE COMPUTED AND ASSERTED HERE FOR THE FIRST TIME --- THE CONTROL'S \$2.10\$ PER BIN AND THE \$4.16\$ BESIDE IT --- AND COMPUTING THEM FINDS THE HARDCODED ONE IS THE WRONG RUN'S.** Until now one lived in a docstring HEADLINE (*"35.5 per bin against the control's 2.10"*, which no check reads, repeated in four more receipts' prose) and the other in a literal division inside an f-string --- `print(f"... \{4.16 / 2.10:>11.2f\}x")` --- in a receipt that computes the two rows beneath it live. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***Measured: the control is \$\textbackslash\{\}mathbf\{2.100902\}\$ per bin on \$133\$ bins (\$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2 = 279.4200\$) and `r6760+cc66.7`'s own arm is \$\textbackslash\{\}mathbf\{4.185607\}\$ (\$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2 = 556.6858\$, which is the \$556.7\$ `FOR\_66` recorded, so the file is identified and not guessed) --- i.e. \$\textbackslash\{\}mathbf\{4.19\}\$, not \$4.16\$.***  **\$4.16\$ is the \$H\_0 = 68.62\$ confirmation run (\$4.157889\$), while the row's own label reads `(r6760+cc66.7)` and the two rows computed live beneath it load the \$68.60\$ arm.** *So three rows of a table whose entire purpose is a LIKE-FOR-LIKE ratio carry two different \$H\_0\$ values.*  ***AND NOTHING MOVES: \$4.16/2.10 = 1.98\$ against \$4.19/2.10 = 1.99\$, and both are the "\$\textbackslash\{\}times2.0\$" the conclusion rests on.*** *A provenance defect, reported as one --- and only a computed row could have told the two apart.*} \ (node 66's `r7109` (3), which refused to reclassify it: *"computed and ASSERTED by a receipt rather than narrated in one headline and hardcoded in another's print --- it is the last live item on the thirteen-figure list"* (= `r7101` Q1)). 
\emph{Computes:} **All checks pass.** The bin count asserted off the spectra and not off the name (\$133\$ each, \$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$ \$100\$--\$1298\$, all three covering the SAME bins so the ratios are matched); the control asserted at \$2.10\$ and the arm at \$4.19\$ **to the two decimals the corpus quotes and not finer**; the arm's \$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2\$ asserted against the \$556.7\$ of record, so the identification of the file is a check rather than an assumption; the \$68.62\$ run asserted at \$4.16\$ **and asserted DISTINGUISHABLE from the \$68.60\$ run at those two decimals**, without which PART 3's whole distinction would be vacuous; the literal read out of the other receipt's SOURCE so the claim is about the file as it stands; and the \$185\$-bin rows recomputed, reproducing that receipt's own quoted \$696\$ unlensed. **CONTROL THAT FIRES: if the two ratios differed at the one decimal the conclusion quotes, the receipt fails itself --- *"then the defect is NOT harmless and this receipt's headline is wrong"*.**
 \emph{Bound:}  **IT DOES NOT CLAIM THE \$\textbackslash\{\}times2.57\$ CONCLUSION IS AFFECTED** --- that comparison is \$185\$-bin lensed against \$185\$-bin unlensed, both computed live there from one arm. **AND IT DOES NOT CLAIM `cc66.7` REPORTED THE WRONG NUMBER:** `cc66.7` reported \$4.19\$ and `FOR\_66` records its \$\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2\$ as \$556.7\$ --- *the reporting was right and the later transcription into a neighbouring receipt's print was not.*  Both stale-premise branches degrade with a named reason rather than failing: if the literal is repaired, or the headline no longer carries \$2.10\$, the receipt says the PART is spent and keeps the assertion that `r7101` actually asked for. NOT CLAIMED: that a deeper run would leave the figures where they are --- they are properties of banked spectra and the published covariance, and what a deeper run moves is the SPECTRA.
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_133\_bin\_pair\_is\_computed\_and\_asserted\_and\_the\_hardcoded\_row\_carried\_the\_other\_arm.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_lowell_sweep_is_reproduced_by_a_producer_in_the_repository_and_the_bank_is_that_producers_output_rounded}{P15R237}\textbf{P15R237}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_lowell\_sweep\_is\_reproduced\_by\_a\_producer\_in\_the\_repository\_and\_the\_bank\_is\_that\_producers\_output\_rounded}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:lowell`, `sec:scope` ---  **ONE OF `70`'s TWO LOAD-BEARING UNPLACEABLES IS CLOSED: `spectra/cc66\_lowell\_sweep.npz` HAS A PRODUCER IN THE REPOSITORY, ALL EIGHT OF ITS BANKED CONFIGURATIONS ARE RE-DERIVED, AND THE BANK IS THAT PRODUCER'S OUTPUT ROUNDED TO FOUR DECIMALS --- EXACTLY, ON ALL \$56\$ VALUES.** `70`'s provenance audit lists it as read by a registered receipt and a published figure with *"no producer in the repository"*, and offers re-derive **or** write the producer in. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***Both are done, because each alone is weaker than it looks: a producer with no re-derivation is a claim about a file, and a re-derivation with no producer closes nothing the next time the question is asked.***  **AND THE ENGINE IS NOT A SECOND COPY OF ANYTHING.** The producer PARSES `P15\_the\_low\_multipole\_depth\_gap\_closes\_and\_two\_defects\_were\_cancelling` and exec's only its arm-B definitions (`\_RUN`, `armB`, `r0\_of`, the two backgrounds) --- *a duplicated engine can drift from the original silently, which is the defect class this corpus keeps naming, and the receipt asserts the duplication has not happened by looking for the harness's own text in the producer.*  ***And the residual is NAMED rather than tolerated: the bank stores four decimals, `round(live, 4)` equals the banked value identically, and the worst raw difference is \$4.9\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-5\}\$ --- half the last stored digit. So the agreement is not "within tolerance"; the bank IS the producer's output.***} \ (node 66's `r7109` (3) (= `r7101`'s second item), carrying `70`'s provenance audit forward: *"the two load-bearing unplaceables re-derived, `cc66\_lowell\_sweep` and `c54.182\_clpp`"*). 
\emph{Computes:} **All checks pass.** **(1)** the producer and its record asserted TRACKED by `git ls-files`, and asserted at source to READ its engine rather than carry one --- **with the converse checked too: the receipt fails if the harness's own program text appears in the producer**, and fails if the receipt stops defining `\_RUN`/`armB`/`r0\_of`, which is what the producer's reader depends on. **(2)** the producer's `CASES` table read out of its source (importing it would run it) and asserted **SET-EQUAL** to the banked key set --- no key unproduced, no case unbanked, and a count would not have caught either. **(3)** one configuration RE-DERIVED LIVE on every run (\textasciitilde{}\$80\$ s), so the producer is exercised and not vouched for. **(4)** all eight read from the producer's own tracked record and **each checked against the BANK rather than trusted** --- a record claiming agreement while the bank disagrees fails on that line and not on its own say-so --- with the value count asserted at \$56\$. **(5)** the bank's stored precision DERIVED from the bank itself (the fewest decimals that leave every value unchanged) rather than assumed, and the raw residual asserted \$\textbackslash\{\}le\$ half the last stored digit.
 \emph{Bound:}  **IT DOES NOT CLAIM THE SWEEP'S PHYSICS IS RE-VALIDATED** --- that is the registered receipt's job and it does it on every run; this closes a PROVENANCE question, that the banked numbers come from code in this repository and can be made again. **AND IT CLOSES ONE UNPLACEABLE, NOT TWO:** `c54.182\_clpp` is explicitly not closed here and is not claimed to be.  *Nor is the four-decimal storage defended --- it was not this seat's choice, it loses nothing at these multipoles, and it is named so the next reader does not mistake \$5\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-5\}\$ for a disagreement.* NOT CLAIMED: that the DECOUPLED variant is cheap --- it is \textasciitilde{}\$9\$ minutes a configuration, which is why the record is banked and only the cheapest case runs live.
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_lowell\_sweep\_is\_reproduced\_by\_a\_producer\_in\_the\_repository\_and\_the\_bank\_is\_that\_producers\_output\_rounded.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_lensing_potential_re_derives_bit_identically_and_the_three_keys_that_do_not_are_a_cross_check_the_producer_never_computed}{P15R238}\textbf{P15R238}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_lensing\_potential\_re\_derives\_bit\_identically\_and\_the\_three\_keys\_that\_do\_not\_are\_a\_cross\_check\_the\_producer\_never\_computed}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:lensing`, `sec:refit-bound` ---  **THE SECOND OF `70`'s TWO LOAD-BEARING UNPLACEABLES IS PLACED, AND MORE CLEANLY THAN THE QUESTION EXPECTED: `spectra/c54.182\_clpp.npz` RE-DERIVES **BIT-IDENTICALLY** FROM A PRODUCER THAT IS IN THE REPOSITORY --- `L171x\_lensing\_potential.py`, AT ITS OWN DEFAULTS, ON THE CURRENT BACKGROUND.** Zero on all four keys that producer writes (`Phi`, `k`, `ls`, and the Limber `cl` the figure is built from). \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***So "no producer" is literally true of the FILE and false of the OBJECT: `70`'s matcher did not find it because it POSTDATES the artefact it makes --- `c54.184` against `c54.182` --- and writes four of its seven keys.***  **AND THAT ANSWERS BY MEASUREMENT THE QUESTION 66 PUT TO `60`:** whether a `c54`-era lensing potential is admissible on the current background at all. *The artefact predates \$\textbackslash\{\}texttt\{LEAFSCALES\}\$ and the current background returns the IDENTICAL arrays, so the switch demonstrably does not move this object --- the reason being in the producer's own docstring (\$\textbackslash\{\}Phi(k,a) = \textbackslash\{\}Phi(k,a\_\{\textbackslash\{\}rm ref\})\textbackslash\{\},g(a)/g(a\_\{\textbackslash\{\}rm ref\})\$ with \$g\$ a BACKGROUND quadrature and no transfer function imported), which this receipt measures rather than quotes.*  ***WHAT DOES NOT RE-DERIVE IS NAMED AND NOT GLOSSED: three of the seven keys --- `cl\_exact`, `cl\_limber`, `l\_exact`, the Limber-against-exact cross-check at eight multipoles --- have no producer, because `L171x` computes the LIMBER integral only.*** *The Limber side of that comparison IS re-derived; what has no producer is the EXACT projection it is compared against.*} \ (node 66's `r7109` (3) (= `r7101`'s second item) and `70`'s provenance audit: *"re-derive, or re-point PART B onto a re-derivable lensing source. It is load-bearing, and its era predates `LEAFSCALES`"*, with 66's added question to `60` about admissibility). 
\emph{Computes:} **All checks pass.** **(1)** the producer's single `savez` QUOTED from its source and asserted to write exactly those four keys --- **so the three-key gap is DERIVED from the producer rather than observed and left unexplained** --- together with its Limber quadrature, which is why no exact side exists to write. **(2)** bit-identity asserted per key on element counts, not on a tolerance: any differing element fails the receipt and says the headline is wrong. **(3)** the unproduced set asserted to BE the Limber-against-exact triple, so a gap that moves is caught rather than re-narrated; and where the cross-check's multipoles sit on the `ls` grid, `cl\_limber` is checked against `cl` so the claim that its Limber column IS this object is tested --- **and when they do not (they do not), the receipt says the comparison is unavailable and that PART 3 then rests on the key names alone**. **(4)** the gap sized by the reading receipt's FIGURE line, quoted from source.  **AND THE READ COUNT GOES THE OTHER WAY --- three against two --- which the receipt reports BEFORE its conclusion and explicitly declines to rest on**, a read count being the wrong measure of load-bearing.
 \emph{Bound:}  **IT DOES NOT RE-POINT PART B AND DOES NOT PROPOSE TO:** that receipt is `c54.184`'s, and with the object re-deriving bit-identically there is nothing to re-point it onto that it is not already reading. **AND IT DOES NOT BUILD THE EXACT PROJECTION** --- new machinery in another seat's instrument --- so the cross-check **stays on the provenance list**, which the receipt says in its own closing line rather than declaring the artefact closed.  *No live re-derivation runs in the receipt, with the cost MEASURED and not asserted: the full run is \textasciitilde{}\$9\$ min (\$220\$ modes carried to \$\textbackslash\{\}eta=4000\$) and a reduced `NKP=12 LMAXPHI=40` run still exceeds two minutes, because the cost is the mode integration and not the mode count --- so the record is banked beside the producer, and compared against the BANK rather than trusted.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_lensing\_potential\_re\_derives\_bit\_identically\_and\_the\_three\_keys\_that\_do\_not\_are\_a\_cross\_check\_the\_producer\_never\_computed.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_layer_is_R_times_S2_on_the_reassigned_chart_and_the_two_presentations_are_two_metrics_on_one_layering_related_by_the_null_reassignment}{P15R239}\textbf{P15R239}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_layer\_is\_R\_times\_S2\_on\_the\_reassigned\_chart\_and\_the\_two\_presentations\_are\_two\_metrics\_on\_one\_layering\_related\_by\_the\_null\_reassignment}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:largescale`, `sec:properframe` ---  **ON THE REASSIGNED CHART A CONSTANT-\$\textbackslash\{\}tilde\textbackslash\{\}tau\$ SURFACE IS \$\textbackslash\{\}mathbb\{R\}\textbackslash\{\}times S\textasciicircum{}2\$, AT EVERY MASS, AND THAT IS WHAT THE REASSIGNMENT DOES.** The induced metric is \$-f(r)\textbackslash\{\},\textbackslash\{\}mathrm d\textbackslash\{\}chi\textasciicircum{}2+r\textasciicircum{}2\textbackslash\{\}mathrm d\textbackslash\{\}Omega\textasciicircum{}2\$ --- \$(\textbackslash\{\}partial\_\textbackslash\{\}chi r)\textasciicircum{}2-1=-f(r)\$ being an identity on the \$E=1\$ worldline --- with intrinsic Ricci eigenvalues \$(0,1/r\textasciicircum{}2,1/r\textasciicircum{}2)\$: a flat line times a round \$S\textasciicircum{}2\$ of radius \$r(\textbackslash\{\}tilde\textbackslash\{\}tau)\$, where a round \$S\textasciicircum{}3\$ needs all three at \$2/a\textasciicircum{}2\$, **computed here and not quoted**.  *This is Daryl's own statement of the reassigned metric and the coordinate fact `r7105` adjudicated, so it is NOT a finding against the corpus: it is pinned so the paper can state the attribution instead of leaving a reader to meet it as a surprise, which happened twice.* \&\#9670; \textit{`sec:interior`'s homogeneous-shear clause --- `the \$S\textasciicircum{}3\$ tensor tower starts at \$L=2\$ and has no \$k=0\$ member`} \ ( **`r7171` ORDER (2), RE-WEIGHTED LOAD-BEARING BY `r7173`: THE TENSOR FLOOR IS DERIVED ON THE CONSTRUCTION'S OWN `\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$` AND THE CLAUSE IS RIGHT AS WRITTEN.** The transverse-traceless rough Laplacian has spectrum `\$L(L+2)-2\$` EXACTLY --- `\$6,13,22,33,46,61,78\$` over seven levels, degrees `\$2\textbackslash\{\}ldots8\$` consecutively, degree multiplicity `\$2(L+3)(L-1)\$` (`\$10,24,42\$`) --- and the MINIMUM over the whole computed space is `\$6\$`, which is `\$L=2\$`. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} ***`\$L=1\$` would need the eigenvalue `\$1\$` and `\$L=0\$` would need `\$-2\$`; NEITHER OCCURS.***  **AND THE `\$k=0\$` MEMBER IS ABSENT BY ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN BY FIAT**: `\$k\textasciicircum{}2=L(L+2)-2=0\$` requires `\$L(L+2)=2\$`, which no non-negative integer satisfies, *so the homogeneous shear has no tensor mode to be* --- which is exactly the use the paper makes of the clause.  ***AND THE FIRST THING THIS RECEIPT DOES IS WITHDRAW THIS SEAT'S OWN REPORT OF A GAP***: at `r7173`-time I reported the space non-empty at every degree including `\$L=0,1\$`, so the floor did not follow from the transverse-traceless condition, with twelve solutions at one degree accounted for by nothing. **That report was a LABELLING error.** The index I read as the degree is the level of the `\$V\_j\$` factor, which **IS** the degree for SCALARS --- the scalar Laplacian at level `\$2j\$` is `\$2j(2j+2)\$`, gated --- and is **NOT** the degree for tensors; *the twelve modes I called `\$L=1\$` carry `\$-\textbackslash\{\}nabla\textasciicircum{}2=13=3\textbackslash\{\}cdot5-2\$`, so they are `\$L=3\$`, the second rung.*  **AND THE INDEX CANNOT BE A DEGREE BECAUSE ONE LEVEL CARRIES TWO**: at `\$2j=4\$` the Laplacian splits the kernel into ONE eigenvector at `\$6\$` and NINE at `\$46\$` --- *an index that splits under the operator whose eigenvalue defines the degree is not that degree.* **Each degree is assembled from two EQUAL halves at `\$2j=L-2\$` and `\$2j=L+2\$`, the two chiralities.**  **AND THE KILLING CONTROL IS STATED WITH ITS LOCATION BECAUSE THE LOCATION IS WHAT I GOT WRONG**: six solutions of `\$\textbackslash\{\}mathcal\{L\}\_\textbackslash\{\}xi g=0\$`, THREE at `\$2j=0\$` and THREE at `\$2j=2\$`, nothing at `\$2j=1\$`; and no tower member is pure gauge --- the kernel meets the gauge image in ZERO at every level.). 
\emph{Computes:} **19 gates, all pass, 4 s.** **(A)** the instrument validated BEFORE use --- the Levi-Civita connection derived from the frame's own bracket (torsion-free at all 27 index triples, metric-compatible at all 27), `\$R\_\{ab\}=2\textbackslash\{\}delta\_\{ab\}\$` exactly, and the scalar Laplacian `\$2j(2j+2)\$` at all seven levels, *which is the gate that states the trap*. **(B)** the Killing control with its location, the zero gauge intersection, and the kernel's Laplacian-invariance checked by residual. **(C)** the kernel non-empty at every level (`\$5,12,21,32,50,72,98\$`), the `\$2j=0\$` eigenvalue `\$6\$` against the `\$-2\$` its index would require, the `\$2j=4\$` split, and the `\$L=1\textbackslash\{\}to L=3\$` withdrawal gated on the number. **(D)** the full spectrum, the minimum, the degeneracies, the chirality halves, and the `\$k=0\$` arithmetic. **(E)** the clause read from the paper verbatim with the two adjacent steps that make it load-bearing. *Exact arithmetic throughout; no tolerance, no sampling, no floating point in any gate, and no assertion on wall-clock time.*
 \emph{Bound:}  **IT IS THE ROUND UNIT `\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$` AND NOTHING HERE SPEAKS TO THE SQUASHED MEMBERS.** *That is the sphere the closed ball carries and the sphere the clause is about, so the scope is the clause's own --- but the squashed members are a DIFFERENT eigenvalue problem, of which `r7184` computed one sector and found the squashing drops out only where the sector descends.*  **And the derivation is of the FLOOR, not of the deficit**: the three sites that carry `\$L=2\$` now rest on a proof rather than on a sentence, and `r7186` already proved the layer's parity does not reach the arriving content, *so what this closes is the stated route and not the unjoined-ness `r7180` measured.*

\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_dipole_parenthesis_is_right_on_its_own_tower_and_does_not_reach_the_other_one_because_the_scalar_floor_is_a_vanishing_traceless_hessian_and_the_tensor_floor_is_an_empty_degree}{P15R271}\textbf{P15R271}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_dipole\_parenthesis\_is\_right\_on\_its\_own\_tower\_and\_does\_not\_reach\_the\_other\_one\_because\_the\_scalar\_floor\_is\_a\_vanishing\_traceless\_hessian\_and\_the\_tensor\_floor\_is\_an\_empty\_degree}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:largescale`'s low-multipole floor sentence --- `the lowest physical mode the quadrupole \$L=2\$ (the monopole \$L=0\$ is the background, the dipole \$L=1\$ pure gauge)` --- against `P16` `sec:interior`'s tensor-tower clause} \ ( **`r7175` ORDER (2) HALF (2), PRE-REGISTERED ON ITS HALF (3): THE DIPOLE PARENTHESIS IS RIGHT ON ITS OWN TOWER AND DOES NOT REACH THE OTHER ONE.** ***Two papers carry an `\$L=2\$` floor on the same `\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$`, for two DIFFERENT towers, by two DIFFERENT derivations*** --- and the agreement of the numbers is arithmetic coincidence rather than a shared mechanism. (1) **THE PARENTHESIS NAMES ITS OWN TOWER IN ITS OWN SENTENCE**: its wavenumber is `\$\textbackslash\{\}sqrt\{L(L+2)\}/r\_0\$`, and `\$L(L+2)\$` is what this `\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$` returns for the SCALAR Laplacian (`\$0,3,8,15,24,35,48\$` measured), while `r7190` measured the transverse-traceless eigenvalue on the SAME sphere as `\$L(L+2)-2\$` (`\$6,13,22,33,46,61,78\$`). *Two numbers, two spins.* (2) **AND IT IS CORRECT ON ITS TOWER, DERIVED RATHER THAN GRANTED**: the degree-one scalar harmonic's traceless second covariant derivative is the ***ZERO MAP*** --- rank `\$0\$` while the FULL Hessian at that degree has rank `\$2\$`, *so it vanishes identically and not for want of modes to act on* --- which is what `pure gauge` means there; and the same map has FULL rank `\$L+1\$` from `\$L=2\$` up.  (3) **BUT NEITHER HALF OF THE QUESTION AS POSED HAS AN ANSWER**: (a) the transverse-traceless tower has NO `\$L=1\$` member to be gauge or not (lowest eigenvalue `\$6\$`; `\$L=1\$` would need `\$1\$`), and (b) the twelve are not pure gauge in any case (the kernel meets the gauge image in ZERO). ***Both measured, and neither settles it, because the question's subject sits at eigenvalue `\$13=3\textbackslash\{\}cdot5-2\$`, which is `\$L=3\$`, and the question names `\$L=1\$`.***  **SO THE CORRECTION OFFERED FOR THIS SEAT'S GAP IS ITSELF A CROSS-SPIN LABEL SLIP, THE SAME CLASS AS THE SEAT'S OWN** --- *this seat read a level index as a degree; the parenthesis offered to account for it is a genuine `\$L=1\$` statement one SPIN over.*  **AND THE COINCIDENCE IS EXACT RATHER THAN NEAR**: the scalar tower floors at `\$2\$` because two degrees that EXIST are excluded (monopole as background, dipole by a vanishing traceless Hessian); the tensor tower floors at `\$2\$` because two degrees DO NOT EXIST (`\$-2\$` and `\$1\$` are not in its spectrum). ***Same number, opposite reason: one tower excludes modes it has, the other has none to exclude.***). 
\emph{Computes:} **16 gates, all pass, 1 s.** **(A)** the pre-registration prior and naming all three outcomes AND the three ways it could be wrong, plus the instrument re-validated rather than inherited (Levi-Civita at all 27 triples, `\$R\_\{ab\}=2\textbackslash\{\}delta\_\{ab\}\$`). **(B)** the paper's sentence read verbatim with its own wavenumber, and the scalar spectrum measured at seven degrees. **(C)** the traceless Hessian's rank at `\$L=0\$` (zero, and the full one zero too --- the background half), at `\$L=1\$` (zero against a full-Hessian rank of `\$2\$` --- the gauge half), and full at `\$L=2\textbackslash\{\}ldots6\$`. **(D)** the transverse-traceless spectrum and gauge intersection RE-MEASURED at the two levels the question turns on rather than carried over. **(E)** the two floors' opposite reasons, both sentences read from their own papers, and the declared-in-advance negative. *Exact arithmetic throughout; no tolerance, no sampling, no floating point in any gate, and no assertion on wall-clock time.*
 \emph{Bound:}  ***THIS IS NOT A SECOND DERIVATION OF `P16`'s FLOOR, and the pre-registration declared that BEFORE the computation ran so it could not be reported as a strengthening.*** *`r7190` derived that floor; nothing here adds to it or touches it.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **The consequence is NEGATIVE and it is about CITATION**: *the parenthesis is not available as support for the clause, and a seat reaching for it would be double-counting across spins --- `r7178`'s own guard turned on this line's work.*  **And it is the ROUND unit `\$S\textasciicircum{}3\$` in both halves**: the squashed members are a different eigenvalue problem and nothing here speaks to them.  *What `66` offered to take --- the print consequences of a real gap --- is not what is owed; there is no gap. What is owed instead is that one of the two sentences cannot be cited for the other.*

\emph{Computes:} **14 gates, all pass, under a second.** **(A)** the stamped count, every verdict, the backlog's new value against its recorded ceiling, the arithmetic that it fell by exactly the number adjudicated, and the pass bounded by AUTHORSHIP --- two receipts, both this line's, zero unadjudicated left on either. **(B)** every note carrying a read, every note carrying its re-check duty, and no note a stub. **(C)** the four kinds partitioning the sixty-six, the code rows checked AGAINST THEIR LITERALS rather than their notes, and the two mis-classification catches. **(D)** what remains, measured: `2170` keys over more than three hundred receipts, fewer than a third of them under this line's own paper. *Reads the baseline as DATA and asserts nothing about any paper, so it cannot break when a paper is reworded --- which is the defect `PO-78` exists to measure. the null curves are `\$\textbackslash\{\}dd r/\textbackslash\{\}dd\textbackslash\{\}tau=v\textbackslash\{\}pm1\$`, giving speeds `\$2\$` and `\$0\$` at `\$v=1\$`, and `\$\textbackslash\{\}dd v/\textbackslash\{\}dd r=-f'/2=-\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$` there by the same identity the companion receipt uses for the bead's acceleration. whose branch is `\$\textbackslash\{\}exp(-2i\textbackslash\{\}omega r\_*)\$` with `\$r\_*=1/3x\$` --- a pole, not a log. **(H) `\$k\$`:** `\$k\_\{\textbackslash\{\}rm th\}=a\_h\textbackslash\{\}kappa=3/2\$` EXACTLY, `\$L=0.8027756\$`, `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell=4.16\$`. **(I) THE SIGNATURE, which `r7187` names as the omission that licensed a wrong sentence, read here inside, `\$f>0\$` and the speeds straddle zero --- static. *The cosmological pattern, and the exact reverse of a black hole's.* And the same `\$2\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$` the indicial equation returns, so the root's SIMPLICITY is forced by the sign of `\$f'\$` and is not a Nariai accident.
 \emph{Bound:}  **THE CROSSING DOES NOT ALTER THE SPECTRUM, AND THE REASON IS CHARACTERISTIC STRUCTURE RATHER THAN A CHOICE OF SLICING.** *`\$2\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$` IS in the equation --- exactly once, as the index of the branch that is not smooth at the seam --- and it cannot enter through the crossing, because that branch is the one carried by the rays that asymptote to the seam instead of crossing it.*  **And the two rates are separated with numbers rather than with an argument:** `\$\textbackslash\{\}tau\$` along the skimming family runs at `\$\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$`, `\$r\_*\$` runs at `\$2\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$` --- exactly twice, which is why the companion receipt's `\$\textbackslash\{\}ln100/\textbar{}f'\textbar{}\$` is half of this file's `\$\textbackslash\{\}ln100/\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$` --- and the trajectory runs on neither: it crosses at speed `\$2\$`, in `\$(2\textbackslash\{\}alpha/3)\textbackslash\{\}mathop\{\textbackslash\{\}rm arccosh\}2=0.877971931\textbackslash\{\}alpha\$` of its own proper time from the seam to the turnaround.  **The `\$k\$` is named even though the factor is `\$1\$`:** the only scale at the crossing is `\$\textbackslash\{\}kappa\$`, so the only comoving wavenumber a thermal factor could have carried is `\$3/2\$` exactly --- `\$L=0.8028\$`, BELOW THE DIPOLE, and `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell=4.16\$` against the first acoustic peak's `\$220.60\$`, a factor `\$53.0\$` that independently reproduces the `\$50.6\$` the two LOCI give on the same leg. \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **A `\$k\$`-independent factor of `\$1\$` is not an amplitude --- it is the identity --- so neither `\$A\_s\$` nor `\$n\_s\$` moves, and the sector's `\$1.57\$` acquires NO parameter address from the lap's one non-degenerate horizon.**  **What is NOT computed: the flux the seam radiates into the lap's future.** *That is a question about the quantum state and it does need the progenitor interior `PO-75` is live on. The TRANSFER did not --- and the one quantity the corpus lacks, the physical `\$\textbackslash\{\}alpha\$`, is not needed either, because the verdict is `\$1\$`, which carries no scale, and the ratio to the first peak is `\$\textbackslash\{\}alpha\$`-free.*

\textit{no paper section --- `PO-78`'s own adjudication baseline and the twenty-four receipt expressions it flags `OPEN`, read as data} \ ( **THE `OPEN` SUBCLASS IS READ IN FULL AND THE FLAG SEPARATES NOTHING: all `24` keys the instrument flags `OPEN` carry the same flag, while `10` of them go RED ON THE SUCCESS of the work they cite, `1` can NEVER go red and never checked the row it names, and `13` are safe. ** *What decides it is the HAYSTACK -- how much of which text, live or frozen -- and not the needle the flag is set by.*  **And two pins carry the SAME token in the SAME file and fail in OPPOSITE directions: `B15` scopes `OPEN` to `PO-3`'s own row and goes red when the row is struck, `Q1` searches the whole file and so never goes red and never checked `PO-5`.** *The `ALT` flag, which marks a pin as already repaired, measures SYNTAX: it fires on one sentence in two spellings and misses a four-arm regex cover.*  **And the worst case was this seat's own -- `A and B or C` parses as `(A and B) or C`, and `B` sought a capitalised needle in a case-folded haystack, so the gate reduced to `C` and the conjunct it was written to check was never read: the arm added to protect a pin was deleting the conjunct beside it.** *Two repairs land here, both on this seat's own files, and the backlog falls `2170` \ensuremath{\to} `2167`.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **21 gates, all pass, under a second.** **(A)** the subclass read at a PINNED commit rather than live, its size, its ownership split from the paths, and the three verdicts moved. **(B)** the flag sets on the eleven that need repair against the thirteen that do not, the seven-class haystack partition, and a computed ground from the literal for every safe reading that sits on a live haystack. **(C)** `B15`'s and `Q1`'s conditions evaluated on three synthetic registers -- open, struck, and nothing-open -- with the must-come-back-wrong control. **(D)** three disjunctions by `ast` and by arm count: two spellings equal under case folding, four regex arms pairwise distinct, and `(A and B) or C` with an unsatisfiable `B`. **(E)** both repairs demonstrated in the world they were written for, and the detector hole measured on two sentences one gate asserts.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***THE BOUND IS AUTHORSHIP, AS AT `r7198`, AND IT IS NARROWER THAN THE READ.*** *All `24` are READ and classified; only `3` are adjudicated, because a verdict says what a gate is FOR and that is its author's.*  *The other `21` go to the channel with the repair shape each needs. And one of the three readings rests on a convention rather than a mechanism: `FOR\_54.md` is taken as append-only, which is practice and not enforced.*  *The detector hole is REPORTED, not gated against the instrument: closing it must not redden this receipt, so the sibling sentence's visibility is printed and not asserted.*

\textit{`prop:flat` and `sec:largescale`'s flat projection, with `sec:properframe`'s placement of the photon bundle and its non-diffeomorphism clause} \ ( **`r7183`'s OFFERED ITEM, TAKEN: CAN THE ONE EQUALITY `PO-70` RESTS ON BE SECONDED FROM ANOTHER SIDE?  THE SEARCH COMES BACK EMPTY, AND WITH A REASON RATHER THAN A LIST OF FAILURES.** *There is exactly ONE independent candidate, the beam side, and it is carried here in closed form:* on the metric `prop:flat` is stated on, the geometry is **exactly Einstein for arbitrary `\$M\$`**, the areal radius is an **exact affine parameter** on both radial null congruences, and the **whole optical tidal matrix vanishes identically** --- Ricci focusing and shear source together --- *so `\$D\_A\textbackslash\{\}propto\textbackslash\{\}lvert r\_0-r\_e\textbackslash\{\}rvert\$`, the difference of areal radii, which is identically the flat slice's own radial separation, reached with the slice's induced metric nowhere among its inputs.*  **AND THEN THE SAME RAYS CARRY A BLUESHIFT WHERE THE CONSTRUCTION HAS `1090.9`** --- `\$1+z=0.0988\$` and `\$0.00787\$`, wrong by `\$10\textasciicircum{}4\$` and `\$10\textasciicircum{}5\$` and wrong in SIGN --- *so they are not the construction's photons: independent, and NOT a support, which is this revision's own pre-registered outcome `(4)` and the one it named in advance as the trap.*  **THE REASON IS STRUCTURAL: `\$D\_M\$`'s two factors are read on two DIFFERENT objects** --- the length on the flat slice, the redshift on the layer --- *and the reassignment joining them is not a diffeomorphism, so a second support would have to be a statement about the reassignment itself.*  *And the size of what the one ground carries is measured: `14011` Mpc flat against `2285` Mpc closed, a factor of `6.133`.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **22 gates, all pass, under three seconds.** **(A)** the equality located in the current source, `prop:flat` RE-DERIVED rather than cited (all 81 Riemann components of the slice), and the factor the one ground carries. **(B)** the pre-registration read back from disk --- five sides and four outcomes fixed before computing, the two conditions, and the row-ending outcome tabled first. **(C)** the Einstein condition, the Killing vector, the affine parameter and the full screen tidal matrix of `eq:proper-frame`, symbolically and for arbitrary `\$M\$`, with a must-come-back-wrong control that a NON-radial ray returns `\$3Mq\textasciicircum{}2/r\textasciicircum{}3\$` for every declared `\$q\$`. **(D)** the observed frequency obtained symbolically and the redshift on the paper's own printed background. **(E)** the two-object reading and the non-diffeomorphism clause. **(F)** the other four sides.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***NOT that no second support can exist --- only that none exists INSIDE EITHER PRESENTATION, which is what was searched.*** *Not that `prop:flat` is weak: it is a theorem and is re-derived here rather than doubted.*  *One FORK is routed and not decided: whether the construction's photons are the constant-`\$\textbackslash\{\}tau\$` lines, in which case the length is the slice's by what the congruence IS and `prop:flat` is constitutive; or whether they are null in another metric of the one layering, which `P15` does not write down. **Which metric the propagation is DEFINED on is an order and not an inference**, and this seat has routed a fork of that shape before rather than deciding it.*  *The beam result is reported for what it is --- a closed-form statement about `eq:proper-frame` --- and not dressed up as a support.*

 \emph{Bound:}  ***NOT that the two backlogs are proved to be one class*** --- *the attribution measurement supports the reading and `19` of `22` is a measurement on ONE backlog, not a proof; the unification is named as a reading, is not written into any gate, and is offered to the gate rather than adopted.*  *And NOT a claim about the other `16`: they are in receipts this seat does not own and are untouched.*

\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_period_difference_null_is_not_significant_because_the_control_has_no_measurable_period_and_the_offset_is_exactly_a_phase_drift_at_fixed_ell_A}{P15R285}\textbf{P15R285}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_period\_difference\_null\_is\_not\_significant\_because\_the\_control\_has\_no\_measurable\_period\_and\_the\_offset\_is\_exactly\_a\_phase\_drift\_at\_fixed\_ell\_A}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`sec:refit-bound`'s remaining open question and `r7197`'s ordered period-difference null ---  **THE ORDERED DIFFERENCE IS `\$0.97\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$` AND THE ERROR IS ALL CONTROL: `\$35.5\$` OF `\$36.3\$`. THE INFORMATIVE COMPARISON IS AGAINST `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`, WHERE THE ARM IS `\$+14.00\$` HIGH AT `\$4.69\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$` --- AND THAT OFFSET IS *EXACTLY* A PHASE DRIFT OF `\$-96.6\textasciicircum{}\textbackslash\{\}circ\$` AT FIXED `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`, BY AN IDENTITY**} \ (node 66's `r7197`: *"the arm's preferred period against the control's as a null, with the period free in both arms and the DIFFERENCE as the statistic"* --- the measurement `cc66.149` named and left unrun, routed here; with three things to keep apart (the difference not either period alone; what a `\$+4.7\$` per cent offset would MEAN given `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$` is right to `\$0.15\$` per cent; and *"if the difference is NOT significant, that is a complete result and I want it in that form"*)). 
\emph{Computes:} **10 checks, all pass, \textasciitilde{}40 s.** \&\#9670; **NO NEW SPECTRUM, NO GRID.** **(A) THE FORWARD MODEL, VERIFIED EXACTLY:** the figure whitens with the inverse Cholesky of the FULL bandpower covariance, not the diagonal; `\$L\textasciicircum{}\{-1\}(\textbackslash\{\}mathrm\{model\}-\textbackslash\{\}mathrm\{data\})\$` rebuilt from `chi2\_of\_spectrum`'s own `X\_DATA`/`COV\_TT` returns all four banked whitened residuals to **one part in `\$10\textasciicircum{}\{-12\}\$` of their own scale** --- one ulp, and *not* bit-exact: the blocked `cholesky`/`inv` sum in an order that depends on the thread count, so the `\$=0\$` this check first asserted was a property of this machine's default threading and could never have held under the runner's `OMP\_NUM\_THREADS=1` (repaired at `cc66.154`) --- and the perturbation reduces to an identity --- `\$L\textasciicircum{}\{-1\}(\textbackslash\{\}mathrm\{model\}-(\textbackslash\{\}mathrm\{data\}+Lz))=w\_\{\textbackslash\{\}rm obs\}-z\$` --- so one draw `\$z\textbackslash\{\}sim N(0,I)\$` shared by both arms carries their correlation instead of assuming it away (checked to `\$10\textasciicircum{}\{-10\}\$`). **(B) THE ORDERED STATISTIC:** `\$\textbackslash\{\}Delta=-35.25\$` against `\$36.29\$`, **`\$0.97\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$`**, `\$56\$` per cent of `\$4000\$` draws at least as extreme. **(C) THE DECOMPOSITION:** arm `\$311.79\textbackslash\{\}pm2.99\$` (`\$1.0\$` per cent), control `\$334.65\textbackslash\{\}pm35.52\$` (`\$10.6\$`), refit `\$308.24\textbackslash\{\}pm8.82\$` --- the control is `\$11.9\textbackslash\{\}times\$` the arm and is the entire error on the difference. **(D) AGAINST `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`:** `\$+14.00\$` (`\$+4.70\$` per cent), **`\$4.69\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$`**, `\$P(p\textbackslash\{\}le\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A)=0.0003\$`; refitted `\$+9.25\$` at `\$1.05\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$`. **(E) ARTEFACT CHECK:** a second harmonic moves the fundamental `\$+0.25\$` and leaves `\$4.90\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$`. **(F) THE IDENTITY:** period `\$312\$` and `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`-with-linear-phase are the same two-dimensional model, RSS identical to `\$0\$`; the drift is `\$-96.6\textasciicircum{}\textbackslash\{\}circ\$` across `\$104\textbackslash\{\}le\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}le1886\$`, `\$0.268\$` of a period over the `\$5.98\$` the range spans.
 \emph{Bound:}  **NOT SIGNIFICANT --- AND THE REASON CARRIES MORE THAN THE NULL.** *The error on the ordered difference is `\$36.3\$`, of which the **control** contributes `\$35.5\$` and the arm `\$3.0\$`. The control's period is measured to `\$11\$` per cent, so **it cannot serve as a null at all**: `the difference, not either period alone` is right as a principle and empty as a statistic here. That is the order's own item 1 arriving from the other side.*  **THE COMPARISON THE DATA CAN MAKE IS AGAINST `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`, AND IT IS `\$4.69\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$`** --- *`\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$` is reproduced to `\$0.15\$` per cent where the control's period is known to `\$11\$`, and fewer than one draw in a thousand puts the arm at or below it. Refitting pulls it to `\$1.05\textbackslash\{\}sigma\$` and widens it threefold, the same pattern the amplitude shows at `cc66.145` in the one quantity that figure does not report. And it is not the fit's artefact: a second harmonic moves the fundamental by `\$+0.25\$`.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **AND ITEM 2'S ANSWER IS NOT `\$r\_s/D\_M\$`.** *A period of `\$312\$` and `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$` with a linearly running phase are the SAME model to zero, so what the residual carries is a **drift of `\$-96.6\textasciicircum{}\textbackslash\{\}circ\$` at the correct spacing** --- and `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$` sets the spacing, right to a part in six hundred, where the offset is `\$31\$` times that error. What could carry a running phase at correct spacing is the peak phase itself, the loading and the driving. **Named, not measured, and not a claim.***  **THE ASSUMPTION THE BANKED DATA CANNOT CARRY, NAMED:** *the four banked spectra are point predictions with no parameter covariance beside them, so this null propagates Planck's noise and nothing else. That is the right error for what was ordered; it is not an error bar on refitting, and the refitted row is the measured stand-in rather than a substitute.*
