(B) the rule applied symbolically: the measure's log-derivative is the constant `3` and contributes no term, the row's own case returns ONE term, the construction in full returns TWO, and the split is verified an identity with residue `0`. (C) three controls --- a `k`-dependent measure returns THREE, a planted fourth factor returns THREE, a product of constants returns NONE. (D) each of the four closed channels assigned to a term by which object it modifies, three inside the multiplier and one inside the amplitude, with the fifth thing the row's list names being the multiplier ITSELF. (E) the transfer term measured and cited rather than recomputed, the other term free, and the register digest-checked unchanged**
 \emph{Bound:}  **AND THE RULE'S FIRST DRAFT GOT THE COUNT WRONG IN THE FLATTERING DIRECTION:** *it dropped terms equal to ZERO instead of terms CONSTANT in `\$k\$`, counted the measure's `3` as a channel and returned THREE --- which is exactly the `fifth channel` this seat went looking for at `r7224`, manufactured out of its own arithmetic. Fixed in one line and recorded in the function's own docstring.*  *The pre-registered THIRD outcome fired alongside the prediction: on the derived enumeration the row's terminal condition is already decided by what the row carries --- one term measured and running, one free and the progenitor's, which is `r6913`'s requirement on the progenitor reached from the other side.*  *NOT filed as a termination: `r7213` restates the row as open, no closure is filed, no fifth channel is named, and the terminal state is the gating seat's to declare.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_enumeration\_derived\_from\_the\_construction\_has\_two\_members\_and\_the\_rows\_own\_identity\_is\_one\_of\_them\_with\_the\_other\_held\_constant.py}
\item[\label{rcpt:S7_the_paper_pins_are_read_by_reversing_the_clause_they_quote_and_only_one_in_four_would_notice}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{S7\_the\_paper\_pins\_are\_read\_by\_reversing\_the\_clause\_they\_quote\_and\_only\_one\_in\_four\_would\_notice}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`PO-78`'s quote-pin baseline read at a pinned commit together with all eighteen corpus paper BODIES --- `1,489` paper-targeted keys, `2.93` million characters of `.tex`, every located site's own CLAUSE extracted and reversed four independent ways} \ ( **THE BACKLOG IS READ BY REVERSAL, AND ONLY ONE IN FOUR OF THE PAPER-TARGETED PINS WOULD NOTICE: `324` OF THE `1,259` READABLE KEYS QUOTE THE POLARITY, THE QUANTITY OR THE NUMBER AND WOULD GO RED IF THEIR CLAUSE WERE TURNED ROUND.** *`935` survive at least one reversal and `475` survive all four --- negation, antonym, quantifier and numeral alike --- each of the `475` exhibiting the reversed clause it stays green on rather than being inferred from the literal's shape.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **It is a NEW class and not a renaming: `34\%` multi-site against `r7201`'s `MULTI`, `1` key overlapping the `OPEN` flag `S3` read, where `r7228` measured none, `475 > 249`, and it runs across `196` of the `256` receipts holding such a key.**  **AND THE TIER THIS RECEIPT WANTED TO LEAD WITH IS REPORTED AS A LIMIT INSTEAD** --- *`362` keys sit in a clause carrying exactly ONE declared auxiliary and the first draft called that `the clause's only assertion`, but a real clause in `BH\_causality\_v2` carries one auxiliary and TWO finite verbs, `carries` being invisible to a list of auxiliaries: an auxiliary list is not a parser, and the headline never needed one.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **26 gates, all pass, about 14 seconds** *(the figures corrected at `r7238`; wrap-tolerant location costs the extra time)*. **(A)** the instrument seeded BOTH WAYS on four planted cases before it is pointed at anything --- a quoted polarity lands `DISCRIMINATING`, a bare noun phrase lands `REVERSAL`, a clause with nothing to move lands `UNFLIPPABLE`, a quoted numeral lands `DISCRIMINATING`. **(B)** `1,489` keys and `18` bodies at the pin, the three verdicts PARTITIONING the `1,140` readable and the four limit buckets accounting for the other `349`. **(C)** `324` discriminating, `475` reversal, `460` partial, and all three populated so the instrument separates rather than flags. **(D)** every one of the `442` carrying a reversed clause that CHANGED and still contains the literal. **(E)** the overlaps measured, not assumed. **(F)** `98` `ABSENT`, `60` `UNFLIPPABLE`, `18` quoting a reference key, `54` `SATURATED`, each excluded from every verdict, plus the live state as a DISJUNCTION rather than a value and the pinned baseline digest-checked unchanged after the run.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***NOT a verdict on any receipt and NOT a repair*** --- *the `442` are a REPAIR LIST routed in the channel, and adjudicating a baseline key belongs to that baseline's owner.*  *And `DISCRIMINATING` does not mean a pin is GOOD: it means the pin would notice one of four declared reversals, which is a floor and not a certificate.*  *The `218` `ABSENT` keys are not asserted broken --- a needle built at run time or a regex is simply not readable by substring, and that is stated rather than estimated.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L\_probability/S7\_the\_paper\_pins\_are\_read\_by\_reversing\_the\_clause\_they\_quote\_and\_only\_one\_in\_four\_would\_notice.py}
\item[\label{rcpt:S8_the_source_half_is_the_blinder_one_and_the_class_is_mostly_a_receipt_pinning_a_ledger_not_another_receipt}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{S8\_the\_source\_half\_is\_the\_blinder\_one\_and\_the\_class\_is\_mostly\_a\_receipt\_pinning\_a\_ledger\_not\_another\_receipt}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`PO-78`'s quote-pin baseline at a pinned commit and the `1,018`-file receipt tree it points into --- `13.3` million characters of Python source --- plus all eighteen paper bodies re-read so the half `r7228` published can be re-derived rather than quoted} \ ( **THE SOURCE HALF OF THE REVERSAL CLASS IS THE BLINDER ONE: `65` OF `353` READABLE KEYS --- `18.4\%` --- WOULD GO RED IF THE CLAUSE THEY QUOTE WERE TURNED ROUND, AGAINST THE PAPER HALF'S `24.5\%`, `z = 2.77`, `p = 0.0057`.** *So `one in four would notice` is a fact about PAPERS and not about pinning, which is the pre-registered prediction holding and the `indistinguishable` branch --- the one that would have made `r7228`'s framing wrong --- failing to fire.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **AND THE LARGEST EXCLUSION IS AN ANSWER THAT RENAMES THE CLASS:** *`454` keys are absent from every receipt but their own pinner, and in a `120`-key sample `72` are found in the project's own registers or instrument modules, `56` in a register against `28` in a module ---* ***so this half is mostly a receipt pinning a LEDGER, and the baseline's `SOURCE` label means only that the trace did not name a `.tex`.***). 
\emph{Computes:} **17 gates, all pass, about 13 seconds.** **(A)** `r7228`'s transforms, clause extractor, site cap, markup pattern and `classify` SLICED from its pinned source and executed, digest-gated, so a difference between the halves cannot be a difference between instruments. **(B)** both populations at the pin, `1,489` and `1,154`, and the receipt tree asserted to differ from the pin by this file alone. **(C)** the paper half re-derived UNCHANGED --- `279` of `1,140`, `442` surviving all four. **(D)** the source half under two declared filters, with the byte locator's equivalence to `classify` measured identical on all eight shared buckets of a `60`-key sample and the self-site filter shown non-cosmetic (`2` \ensuremath{\to} `27` absent). **(E)** the comparison decided by a two-proportion test rather than by eye, and the third outcome shown not to have fired. **(F)** the exclusions counted and the `ABSENT` bucket sampled to find out what it is.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***NOT a verdict on any baseline key and NOT a repair*** --- *adjudicating a quote-pin belongs to that baseline's owner, as `r7228` said and `r7215` confirmed.*  *And `DISCRIMINATING` is still a floor rather than a certificate: it means the pin would notice one of four declared reversals.*  *The `60\%` figure is a `120`-key SAMPLE of the `469`, reported as a sample; and the prose rule calls a gate label CODE, which is stated as its limit rather than hidden.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L\_probability/S8\_the\_source\_half\_is\_the\_blinder\_one\_and\_the\_class\_is\_mostly\_a\_receipt\_pinning\_a\_ledger\_not\_another\_receipt.py}
\item[\label{rcpt:S9_the_exposure_is_zero_so_the_count_judgement_was_right_and_the_class_was_already_registered_before_it}\textbf{}\quad\texttt{S9\_the\_exposure\_is\_zero\_so\_the\_count\_judgement\_was\_right\_and\_the\_class\_was\_already\_registered\_before\_it}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{the `131` receipts that name a root register as a file they read, found from their own sources rather than from a list; each one's assertion CONDITIONS evaluated against the register before and after the two edits `r7215` actually made; plus `r7224` at its pre-repair commit against the register at its pre-strike commit, as the instrument's recall control} \ ( **THE EXPOSURE IS ZERO, SO THE COUNT JUDGEMENT WAS RIGHT --- AND THE CLASS WAS ALREADY ON THE RECORD, WHICH IS THE HALF THAT WAS NOT.**  *`r7232` pre-registered `several, not one` and the answer is NONE: of `102` receipts carrying an evaluable condition, not one loses an assertion when a row it names is struck or its clause amended. The pass condition is not met and the branch that fired is the second one named in advance --- `in which case r7217's judgement is right and I will say so in those words`.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **And the instrument is NOT cleared on that zero, because the same branch said a zero might mean the test is blind:** *pointed at `r7224` before its repair against the register before the strike, it catches the condition that actually broke, under `AMEND` --- the right transform, since the strike MOVED the row's clause while only WRAPPING its id --- and `r7224` as repaired is immune, which was the pre-registered positive control.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **`O1`'s own account names SIX registered ids of this class and lists `r7224`'s disguise explicitly as `a live register read negatively`,** *so `if it happens a second time it is a member` rests on a first that was not one; and the pin-plus-disjunction repair this seat reached was already prescribed there as `pinned to the parent and carries the opposite live assertion`.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **29 gates, all pass, about 2 seconds.** **(A)** five planted conditions, each landing in the bucket named for it, plus the instrument shown to be at the level of the ASSERTION and not the literal --- a disjunction survives while one arm stands, which is what keeps `r7224`'s own repair from reading as exposed --- and an unreadable condition returning `UNKNOWN` rather than a guess. **(B)** the population found from the sources, `131` of them, and the transforms shown to reach only `8` of the `34` registers named. **(C)** the buckets partitioning all `131`, with `102` immune and the exposed set empty. **(D)** the recall control on the case that happened. **(E)** the prior art read out of `O1`'s docstring in its own words. **(F)** the prediction reported AS failed.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***A zero is NOT a clean bill*** --- *`26` receipts read a register the transforms cannot reach and `3` carry no readable condition, and none of the `29` is counted clean.*  *A condition built at run time, a regex pin, or a literal assembled from parts is invisible to a static read, and that is stated rather than estimated.*  *Nothing is filed and nothing is gated: `r7217` declined both and this supports the decision rather than reopening it. The novelty correction is a reading of an existing record, not a new class.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/L\_probability/S9\_the\_exposure\_is\_zero\_so\_the\_count\_judgement\_was\_right\_and\_the\_class\_was\_already\_registered\_before\_it.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_spacing_drift_is_made_in_the_projection_so_the_construction_determines_it_and_the_handover_contributes_nothing}{P15R301}\textbf{P15R301}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_spacing\_drift\_is\_made\_in\_the\_projection\_so\_the\_construction\_determines\_it\_and\_the\_handover\_contributes\_nothing}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{the acoustic comb's own source extrema in `\$k\$` at recombination on four runs of the two-arm instrument --- driven, undriven, and the handover epoch moved a DECADE either side --- plus the instrument's saved term-by-term source on a UNIFORM `\$k\$` grid at half the ladder's quantum, the banked arm and control spectra, and one configuration banked BOTH ways so the ladder can be compared with a continuum} \ ( **THE PEAK-SPACING DRIFT IS A QUANTITY THE CONSTRUCTION DETERMINES, AND IT IS MADE ENTIRELY IN THE PROJECTION: THE ACOUSTIC PHASE CARRIES NO DRIFT AT ALL.** *The source comb in `\$k\$` lands on the integers undriven to `\$0.015\$` and, driven, is displaced by a nearly CONSTANT `\$-0.12\$` in `\$q=k r\_s/\textbackslash\{\}pi\$` --- a spread of `\$0.029\$` over six peaks --- so its own drift is `\$+0.03\$` to `\$+0.56\$` against a measured `\$+4.38\$`, inside its own rms of zero.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **A PERFECT comb, extrema exactly on the integers with no dynamics behind them, acquires the whole drift on projection: gaps `\$278.5\textbackslash\{\};289.5\textbackslash\{\};293.4\textbackslash\{\};295.4\$`, rising, decelerating and saturating under `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\_A\$`.**  ***And it is DERIVED rather than measured: replacing `\$j\_\textbackslash\{\}ell(kD)\textasciicircum{}2\$` by its own asymptotic average `\$1/(x\textbackslash\{\}sqrt\{x\textasciicircum{}2-\textbackslash\{\}ell\textasciicircum{}2\})\$` reproduces the full Bessel sum peak by peak to under `\$0.5\$` in `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$` and the drift to `\$0.01\$`, so the drift is the centroid shift of the kernel's own window acting on a damped comb and its only inputs are `\$r\_s\$`, `\$D\_M\$` and `\$r\_D\$`.***  **THE HANDOVER --- the one place `r7221` named as this construction's rather than anybody's --- SUPPLIES NONE OF IT:** *a DECADE of handover epoch moves the comb `\$0.30\$` in `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$` and the drift `\$0.002\$`, which is `Prop. subhorizon`'s `is an amplitude and not a phase` measured instead of quoted.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **31 gates, all pass, about 34 seconds.** **(A)** the undriven guard --- every source extremum an integer to `\$0.015\$` --- read off a run that carries `NODRIVE=1` rather than inferred. **(B)** the driven comb's offset shown CONSTANT on a uniform grid at half the ladder's quantum, so the null is not the ladder's resolution talking. **(C)** a perfect comb projected two independent ways, the closed-form window against the full Bessel sum, agreeing peak by peak and on the drift, and the instrument's own saved source re-projected to the same number. **(D)** the handover lever, and the paper's clause pinned for the historical state and read live as a DISJUNCTION over the states a rewording may produce. **(E)** ladder against continuum on one configuration, and the derived drift under a doubled `\$k\$` sampling and a halved `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$` step. **(F)** arm against control on the drift, on every peak position, and with the driving removed entirely. **(G)** the pre-registered prediction scored, the two FAILED parts asserted AS failures. **(H)** what is not settled, gated as a fraction rather than as a whole.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***The closed form reaches `\$+2.61\$` against the reporting path's `\$+4.38\$`: `\$60\$` per cent of the SIZE is derived here and the remainder sits in the multipole hierarchy's damping, which the closed form carries as one Gaussian.***  *Five peaks against four comb parameters leave ONE degree of freedom, so `\$D\$` and the alternation are not independently well determined --- which is why every comparison here is like with like rather than a single coefficient quoted as a measurement.*  *The control's SOURCE comb is not measured: both attempts were killed for memory at `\$7\$` GB a process, and the control's PROJECTED spectrum stands in for it.*  *The ladder-against-continuum pair is a SUPERSEDED configuration whose comb rides the stacking ruler; it is used for the sampling comparison alone and for nothing else.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_spacing\_drift\_is\_made\_in\_the\_projection\_so\_the\_construction\_determines\_it\_and\_the\_handover\_contributes\_nothing.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_kernels_phase_difference_between_the_arms_is_four_orders_below_the_residual_so_the_projection_is_cleared_and_a_sixth_of_the_scale_is_common_mode}{P15R302}\textbf{P15R302}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_kernels\_phase\_difference\_between\_the\_arms\_is\_four\_orders\_below\_the\_residual\_so\_the\_projection\_is\_cleared\_and\_a\_sixth\_of\_the\_scale\_is\_common\_mode}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{the three lengths each arm's own run reports --- `\$r\_s\$`, `\$D\_M\$` and the diffusion scale at the visibility peak --- read off the banked spectra and their run logs rather than typed, and the projection kernel evaluated on them by two independent routes: `r7234`'s closed-form asymptotic window read as a COMPLEX integral, and the full spherical-Bessel sum with no asymptotic average anywhere in it} \ ( **THE KERNEL'S PHASE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE ARMS IS `\$-0.0141\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` ACROSS `\$104\textbackslash\{\}le\textbackslash\{\}ell\textbackslash\{\}le1886\$` AGAINST A RESIDUAL OF `\$-96.6\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` --- `\$3.84\$` ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE BELOW --- SO THE KERNEL IS NOT A CARRIER AND THE PROJECTION IS CLEARED.** *The phase is a function of exactly TWO dimensionless numbers, verified by scaling all three lengths together for the same phase to `\$10\textasciicircum{}\{-10\}\$` degrees: `\$r\_D/D\_M\$`, which the arms differ in by `\$0.27\$` per cent and which carries `\$-0.0139\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` of the difference, and `\$r\_s/D\_M = \textbackslash\{\}theta\_*/\textbackslash\{\}pi\$`, which they share to `\$1.5\textbackslash\{\}times10\textasciicircum{}\{-5\}\$` because the angle is what the construction computes and which carries `\$-0.0001\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$`.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **The closed-form window and the full Bessel sum agree on the difference to five decimal places, `\$-0.01406\$` against `\$-0.01407\$`.**   ***AND THE UNDER-SAMPLED BESSEL SUM MANUFACTURES A DIFFERENCE `\$74\$` TIMES THE TRUE ONE:*** *at `\$1.8\$` points per Bessel period it reads `\$-1.05\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$`, at `\$4.6\$` and above `\$-0.01407\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` through a sixfold further refinement, while the window route is immune because it averages the kernel analytically --- the instrument's own documented aliasing failure arriving in the PHASE rather than in the peaks.*  **And the pre-registered THIRD OUTCOME holds alongside `cleared`:** *the kernel's own ABSOLUTE running phase is `\$-15.46\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$`, `\$16.0\$` per cent of the residual and common mode to `\$0.09\$` per cent, so `a running phase at correct spacing` carries a projection-manufactured floor of a sixth of the scale the row reads its candidates against.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **24 gates, all pass, about 20 seconds.** **(A)** the identity first --- scale invariance under a common rescaling of all three lengths, and the two arms' separation into a shared ratio and a differing one. **(B)** the two routes against each other on each arm and on the difference, each shown converged in its own parameter. **(C)** the aliasing threshold located rather than asserted, with the inflated value, the stable value and the window route's immunity all gated. **(D)** the answer in the one form the order asked for, plus the two-number decomposition the identity predicted. **(E)** the prediction scored, with the FAILED sign asserted as a failure and its root cause measured. **(F)** the third outcome, pre-registered and gated. **(G)** the `\$r\_D\$` convention declared, its sensitivity measured, and the difference re-run at a shifted convention to show it cancels.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***The phase here is the KERNEL's, not the full transfer's*** --- *the driving and the baryon loading remain the row's standing candidates and nothing in this receipt touches them.*  *`\$r\_D\$` is read at the visibility peak because that is the figure the runs report, and the diffusion length is itself `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$`-dependent, so a single value is a CHOICE; what defends the answer is that it is a difference of two arms at the same choice, re-run at a shifted one and unchanged.*  *The residual's `\$-96.6\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` is quoted from `sec:refit-bound` and not re-measured here.*
\ \emph{Run:} \texttt{python3 receipts/P15\_CR\_cosmology/P15\_the\_kernels\_phase\_difference\_between\_the\_arms\_is\_four\_orders\_below\_the\_residual\_so\_the\_projection\_is\_cleared\_and\_a\_sixth\_of\_the\_scale\_is\_common\_mode.py}
\item[\rcptlabel{P15_the_wrap_fix_is_applied_and_agrees_key_for_key_and_the_exposed_convention_is_the_window_not_the_endpoint}{P15R303}\textbf{P15R303}\quad\texttt{P15\_the\_wrap\_fix\_is\_applied\_and\_agrees\_key\_for\_key\_and\_the\_exposed\_convention\_is\_the\_window\_not\_the\_endpoint}]\hfill\textsf{[OK]}\\
\textit{`70`'s banked wrap-tolerant split from `r7223`, diffed KEY FOR KEY against an independent implementation of the same rule in this seat's own `S7` and `S8`; plus the diffusion length at BOTH endpoint conventions from `cc66`'s own standalone integration re-run at the one-clock grid's parameters, and `r7236`'s kernel-phase floor re-evaluated at both conventions and over six `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$`-windows} \ ( **ITEM (1): SIX ROWS, SIX EXACT AGREEMENTS --- AND `70`'s BANK CAUGHT A BUG IN THIS SEAT'S OWN PREFILTER FIRST.** *`ABSENT` `218`\ensuremath{\to}`98`, `REVERSAL` `442`\ensuremath{\to}`475`, `DISCRIMINATING` `279`\ensuremath{\to}`324` on the paper half; source `ABSENT` `469`\ensuremath{\to}`454`, `CODE` `218`\ensuremath{\to}`202`, `REVERSAL+PARTIAL` `270`\ensuremath{\to}`288` --- every one `70`'s number to the digit, with the headline strengthening to `25.7` per cent against `18.4` and `z = 2.84`.*  *It did NOT agree at first: two `'3 nu'` keys split the other way because the byte prefilter fell back to the RAW literal whenever no token reached four characters, silently reintroducing the blindness for short-token keys. **A total that agreed would have hidden it; the key-by-key diff is what found it.***  **And the shared rule has a FALSE POSITIVE neither implementation named:** *widening a literal's spaces to `\$\textbackslash\{\}backslash\$s+` lets `'3 nu'` match `2K\_3` and `null` across a line break, and that spurious site is what carries those two keys.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} **ITEM (2): THE ENDPOINT MOVES THE FLOOR `\$0.085\$` PERCENTAGE POINTS, `\$16.01\$` TO `\$15.92\$`, SO `a sixth` IS SAFE --- AND THE PRE-REGISTERED THIRD OUTCOME FIRES BY A FACTOR OF `\$177\$`: THE `\$\textbackslash\{\}ell\$`-WINDOW MOVES IT `\$15\$` POINTS, FROM `\$9.11\$` PER CENT TO `\$24.13\$`.**   ***AND THE ARM-CONTROL DIFFERENCE IS NOT CONVENTION-SAFE, WHERE `r7225` SAID IT WAS:*** *the two arms' `\$r\_D\$` move in OPPOSITE directions, `\$+1.59\$` per cent against `\$-1.51\$`, so their separation in `\$r\_D/D\_M\$` goes `\$0.27\$` to `\$2.79\$` per cent and the kernel phase difference goes `\$-0.0141\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` to `\$+0.1448\textasciicircum{}\{\textbackslash\{\}circ\}\$` --- a factor of ten and a change of SIGN, with `\$1.59+1.51=3.10\$` reproducing `cc66`'s straddle-zero figure on a different configuration. `r7236`'s clearance survives at `\$2.82\$` orders, and its reported sign was never convention-independent.*). 
\emph{Computes:} **29 gates, all pass, about 39 seconds.** **(A)** `S7` and `S8` re-run as subprocesses rather than reimplemented, their counts read off their own output, and all six of `70`'s rows checked to the digit. **(B)** the key-by-key diff against `70`'s bank, with the prefilter's removed length floor and the uncollapsed haystack both asserted from the source. **(C)** the false positive EXHIBITED on its own literal rather than described. **(D)** the two pins, and the population shown to be the one `r7230` measured. **(E)** the floor at both conventions, reproducing `r7236`'s published figure at the shipped one. **(F)** the difference's convention dependence, its factor of ten, its sign change and the surviving clearance. **(G)** the third outcome, with the prediction's band held and its central value gated AS high by two. **(H)** what is not settled.
 \emph{Bound:}  ***The endpoint swings are applied as a RATIO to the instrument's own reported `\$r\_D\$`*** --- *the standalone integration and the instrument's hierarchy-derived `\$r\_D\$` differ in absolute value, a gap `cc66`'s own receipt documents, and the convention question is about the ratio.*  *The false positive is exhibited on one literal and NOT counted across the backlog, so how much of the corrected `\$120\$` rests on cross-token matches is unmeasured.*  *Nothing here adjudicates a baseline key: the corrected buckets are a measurement and the verdicts stay the baseline owner's.*

lifted from its pinned blob, and the shared pin ledger; every exact number read at a pinned commit and every live population gated monotone} \ ( **`r7227` ITEM (1), AND THE ANSWER IS ABOUT THE SWEEP AND NOT THE CLASS: `S4` SWEPT THIS SEAT'S WORK FOR `an exact count asserted against a set other seats can grow`, REPORTED ONE LIVE INSTANCE, AND THREE OF THIS SEAT'S RECEIPTS THEN WENT RED ON AN EXACT \textit{no paper section --- the live tree's own claim-sites of the exact-count class, each one's LAST WRITER from `git blame`, the parity of the revision that introduced each receipt in the path scope, the three blobs the gating seat edited at `r7227` before and after, and a receipt-shaped CONTROL carrying one genuine site of the class} \ ( **`r7229` ANSWERED AND THE FORMULATION IS ONE LINE: KEEP THE POPULATION LIVE AND RESTRICT THE ASSERTION TO THE CLAIM-SITES WHOSE LAST WRITER IS IN THIS PUSH'S OWN RANGE.** *Self-including by construction --- shown on a control that is INSIDE the asserted set when its line is this push's and OUTSIDE it when the same line is attributed to another seat's commit --- monotone, since not one site it asserts on was last written by a revision of the gating seat's parity, and immune to a base merge, because `blame` attributes a merged line to the commit that WROTE it.*  ***AND THE PRE-REGISTERED COVERAGE BAND HOLDS: `2`--`12` of the live claim-sites with a central guess of `6`, measured `7` of `83`.***  *But the first draft of this receipt measured that coverage as ZERO, twice over and for two reasons of the same shape --- **`blame` marks an uncommitted LINE with an all-zero sha and `ls-files` omits an untracked FILE**, so the sweep could not see its own receipt in the state it was actually run in. Both are repaired and both are gated, and the second was caught by CI rather than by this seat.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow} *And the coverage of a self-including sweep is set by the DETECTOR and not by the scope rule --- here the detector can see this revision's counts only because the control quotes the shared ledger's path, and a revision reading its population through `git` alone would have scored zero.*  **SO THE ANSWER HAS BOTH HALVES: IT EXISTS, IT IS SAFE, AND IT IS A PER-PUSH GATE RATHER THAN A SWEEP** --- *retrospective coverage measured at exactly zero, so the standing check routed at `r7240` is the only coverage the class already standing can ever have, which is `r7229`'s own closure read in the stronger direction.*   ***AND THE POPULATION `S4` DEFINED AND `r7240` INHERITED IS MOSTLY ANOTHER SEAT'S WORK: `116` of the receipts in it were introduced by a revision of this line's parity against `180` of the gating seat's.*** *The directory is SHARED, four of its claim-sites are last written by other seats' revisions right now --- named in the receipt --- so a path-scoped sweep already asserts on another seat's work, and the thing `r7229` contrasted against is the present state of one.*  *That is a correction to this seat's own previous revision and not to the order: `r7240`'s denominators are right about the set they measured and wrong about whose set it is, and the two findings they carry --- the detector blindness and the pinned sweep --- are properties of the instrument and do not move.* \ensuremath{\Rightarrow}  **AND THE PRE-REGISTERED THIRD OUTCOME FIRES: the gating seat's edits REMOVED claim-sites and added none, `31` to `29` with the exposed bucket `3` to `2`** --- *the prescribed repair turns `==` into `<=`, which deletes a site rather than creating one, so path-scoping is unsafe in principle and safe in the only direction the record exhibits.*). 
\emph{Computes:} `22` gates. (1) the rule, built and run: live population, assertion scoped to the push range with the WORKING TREE counted, since `blame` marks an uncommitted line with an all-zero sha and a range test alone would have passed locally by vacuity and engaged only in CI. (3) the coverage scored against the pre-registered band, which holds, with both of the first draft's see-itself failures gated rather than remembered. (4) retrospective coverage measured at zero. (5) the path scope partitioned by the parity of each receipt's introducing revision. (6) the four foreign-written claim-sites named individually. (7) the `r7227` edits measured before and after. (8) and the parity heuristic's own flaw measured rather than waved at: the EVEN-id commits of the gating seat last wrote no claim-site

whose last writer carries one and vacuous on the rest.*).

(6) the positive-control split measured by looking for a non-zero counter assertion in each receipt. (7) the one genuine site named with its own source line. (8) the band scored.
